t: An open design robot built from 3D-printed parts and a Raspberry Pi.
steps: Find the FOSSBot design files and software in the project article.
Print the parts on a 3D printer.
Gather a Raspberry Pi, a 32 GB microSD card, motors, sensors and 18650 batteries.
Wire the electronics. The assembly instructions are in Greek only.
Flash the software to the SD card.
Try the simulator and a first Blockly program.
